title: MobileShop – E-commerce & Service Platform
description: A full-stack e-commerce platform with product management, order processing, and an integrated admin dashboard.
longDescription:
MobileShop is a modern enterprise-grade e-commerce and service management platform designed to provide a premium digital storefront along with a powerful administrative control system.

The platform is built using a Turborepo monorepo architecture, allowing the frontend, backend, and shared packages to scale efficiently while maintaining consistent code across the project.

The customer storefront, developed with Next.js 14, provides a fast and responsive shopping experience where users can browse mobile devices, purchase accessories, and book repair services.

The enterprise admin dashboard offers a centralized management interface for handling products, orders, users, and service requests. The dashboard follows a corporate dark theme design with glassmorphism and neon accent styling, creating a modern enterprise aesthetic.

On the backend, Express.js with Node.js manages authentication, product operations, order processing, and business logic. MongoDB with Mongoose schemas handles structured data storage.

Reusable components and shared configurations are maintained in shared packages, ensuring consistent UI design and development standards across the entire platform.

title: Expenzo
description: A secure full-stack expense tracking platform with real-time financial analytics, interactive dashboards, and enterprise-grade security.
longDescription:
Expenzo is a modern personal finance management platform designed with a premium corporate dashboard experience. The system helps users track income, manage expenses, and visualize financial trends through interactive charts and analytics.

The application combines a clean high-fidelity UI with strong backend security practices, making it more than just a basic expense tracker. Users can securely log transactions, categorize spending, analyze monthly patterns, and export financial reports for deeper analysis.

The frontend is built using React with Vite for fast performance, while Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion create a smooth and modern interface. The backend uses Express and MongoDB to handle authentication, financial records, and reporting features.

Special attention was given to security hardening, including JWT authentication, input validation, rate limiting, and protective HTTP headers.

The project demonstrates how a financial system can combine clean design, data visualization, and secure backend architecture into a professional-grade application.
